scope_guard: Results are specific to the tested VAT and FinanceBench harnesses. Verification costs, oracle privilege, false-positive costs, rollback policies and verifier independence differ in other systems. No universal claim that all boundaries should be verified or that all multi-agent systems amplify hallucinations is made.
